en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a large public square bordered by historic buildings. To the right is a grand cathedral with a rose window and a tall bell tower topped with a dome. In the middle of the square is a fountain. To the left, a tall clock tower rises above the surrounding buildings. There are a few people scattered throughout the square. The text printed on the image reads 'Piazza del Duomo e Torre Grande' and 'Trento'.
